source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Family Fun, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Team Nutrition

steps.instruction: Add 4 eggs, 2 tablespoons of frozen corn and 1 tablespoon of milk to a large bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons green pepper, 1/4 cup onion and 1 tablespoon tomatoes.
Add 1 teaspoon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, hot pepper sauce and salt.
Blend for 1 minute, until the eggs are smooth.
Pour the egg mixture into a 9-by-9-inch dish lightly coated with cooking oil.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the eggs are set and thoroughly cooked.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-five minutes, until the eggs are set and thoroughly cooked.

steps.instruction: Microwave the wrapped tortillas for 20 seconds, until warm.
steps.spoken: Microwave the wrapped tortillas for 20 seconds, until warm. Be careful when unwrapping them. The steam can be hot.

steps.instruction: Cut the baked egg mixture into 4 equal pieces.
Roll 1 piece of cooked egg in each tortilla.
Top each burrito with 2 tablespoons of salsa.
